draft_reason: services/* contains shared runtimes and protocol embryos that are not organs but still need explicit topology ownership.
promotion_condition: each service surface has a stable class, owner, evidence, and promotion/migration decision after its open membrane is closed.
purpose: Classify every immediate services/<name>/ surface so shared runtimes and protocol services do not become hidden organs or undocumented source islands.

protocol_service_embryo.rule: A protocol service embryo may exist while its service-vs-organ boundary and runtime contract are still being decided.
protocol_service_embryo.exit_condition: promote to shared/runtime service contract, migrate into a bounded organ, or quarantine/delete before treating it as canonical

quarantined.rule: A quarantined service surface is not active runtime truth and must not be used as an organ substitute.
quarantined.exit_condition: delete, migrate, or reclassify after its runtime boundary and owner are explicit

shared_runtime_framework.rule: A shared runtime framework is canonical only as reusable substrate consumed by multiple organs or agents.
shared_runtime_framework.exit_condition: keep while multi-consumer evidence exists, otherwise migrate the code into the owning organ

transitional.rule: A transitional service surface has known boundary debt and must not accumulate new responsibilities.
transitional.exit_condition: promote, quarantine, or migrate after the declared next_action is resolved
